title: prep-worktree walker-mode: resolve primary-repo node_modules when called from inside a walker worktree (bug #4)
definition_of_done: reference-impl/lib/prep-worktree.ts no longer unconditionally uses its first argument as the node_modules source root; it either walks up from the provided mainRoot to find a directory containing both standard/node_modules and reference-impl/node_modules, or it accepts an explicit --primary-root flag passed via cli.ts
cloverleaf-cli prep-worktree succeeds when mainRoot is a walker worktree path (a peer worktree without installed deps) by locating the actual primary repo root
Changes pass the existing reference-impl test suite
acceptance_criteria: Calling prep-worktree with a mainRoot that is a fresh walker worktree (no node_modules) succeeds by walking up to find the actual primary repo root (reproduces bug #4)
Calling prep-worktree with the actual primary repo root continues to work as before (regression guard)
The error message 'main missing standard/node_modules' is not emitted when called from a walker context where node_modules exist in a parent directory
reference-impl/lib/prep-worktree.ts is the sole file modified (no changes to standard/ or unrelated CLI commands)
